sentence: This project builds a drug delivery system called Cargocytes that tries to limit drug toxicity.
This project tests whether T cells aimed at one protein on glioblastoma cells can treat the tumor safely.
This project builds genetically encoded tags that let researchers see proteins under light and electron microscopes.
This project builds a tool that uses past radiological and clinical data to predict the risk and severity of intimate partner violence in patients.
This project tries to find out what conserved proteins of unknown function do in the metabolism of prokaryotes.
This project tests whether DNA-encoded library technology can find compounds that treat amphetamine use disorders.
This project uses image registration and deep learning on lung scans to find zones of the lung that look normal but have abnormal mechanics.
This project develops computational and data science methods for sensing and imaging data.
This project builds a platform that joins flexible electronic sensors with heart tissue grown from stem cells to track and guide how the tissue matures.
This project studies immune gene patterns and proteins to find which people are at high risk of progressing to leukemia or lymphoma.
This project studies whether posttraumatic stress disorder raises the risk of autoimmune disease in veterans and which factors raise or lower that risk.
This project studies how networks of RNA binding proteins and their targets go wrong in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
This project studies how parent substance use and prenatal exposure shape risky behaviors in adolescents through parent-child interactions.
This project follows patients given gene therapy with a lentivirus vector and low dose busulfan to check immune recovery and safety.
This project develops computational methods and CRISPR screens to find non-protein-coding regions of the genome that drive tumor growth.
This project tries to develop small molecules that act against schistosomiasis and to find out how they work.
This project studies the genes and epigenetic changes that guide how trophoblast progenitor cells become the cell types of the human placenta.
This project studies how mothers and fathers each shape the immune system of the fetus and how environmental stressors affect it differently by sex.
This project runs shared research services, including experimental models and imaging, for vision researchers.
This project uses tumor slices from patients and mouse models with single-cell analysis to test how drugs affect cell groups in glioblastoma and nearby brain.
